nodes.name: check_sql_post.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code hook that validates SQL schema compatibility after Python file edits, running schema checks and feeding back validation errors to prevent schema drift.
nodes.languageNotes: Shell hook using Python subprocess calls and JSON I/O for Claude Code integration; supports both make and direct Python fallback for environment portability.

nodes.name: guard_env_pre.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code hook that enforces the paper-first trading rule by requiring explicit user approval before any .env file modifications, preventing accidental live trading config changes.

nodes.name: guard_live_pre.sh
nodes.summary: Claude Code hook that blocks shell commands setting TRADING_MODE=live without explicit user approval, enforcing a hard safety boundary for paper trading mode enforcement.
